data.name: Sephira
data.long_meaning: Sephira is a Hebrew name derived from the biblical Sephirot, the ten divine emanations of God. It is believed to represent the divine feminine, symbolizing wisdom, understanding, and secret knowledge. In Jewish mysticism, Sephira is associated with the goddess Shekhinah and the earthly manifestation of God's presence.
